shots.detail_en: Deep-night back room of a cha chaan teng, single tungsten bulb; young man in white shirt pins the notebook's first page, a hand-drawn candlestick chart, onto the wall, first paper of the war room
shots.sub: 爸，这一仗，从你那页纸开打。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: The bulb sways slightly, the pinned chart's shadow swaying with it across peeling paint
Round-faced man in floral shirt pushes a canvas money bag to the middle of the table, both hands pressed on its mouth
shots.sub: 重建的钱，全给你操盘——我一分不留。
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Close-up: the young man's hand pushes the bag straight back along the same path
shots.speaker: 长虹
shots.fx: bag sliding back on the table

shots.detail_en: Young woman reaches out and presses her hand flat on the bag, eyes fixed on the young man across the table
shots.sub: 要打翻身仗，先不能把命再押给别人。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: The round-faced man scratches his head, glancing from the bag to the two of them
shots.sub: 不让全仓……那还叫满仓吗？
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Young man slides a brand-new account book to the round-faced man and opens its first page
shots.sub: 一样打仗，两样账——亏，各亏得起。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Young woman stands up, ledger closed and clamped under her arm, calculator lanyard swinging
shots.sub: 账我管。审计、情报——数字站在哪一边，我一眼就看得见。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: The round-faced man slaps his own chest, floral shirt puffing out
shots.sub: 人我管。散户厅的耳朵——谁家割肉、谁家加仓，我门儿清。
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Young man raises his hand toward the pinned hand-drawn candlestick chart on the wall
shots.sub: 盘我管。策略、信号——线想说什么，我替它翻译。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: The three around the table exchange a look and each nods once
Young man steps directly under the bulb, voice low, half his face in warm light
shots.sub: 熊家躲在暗处做局——我们就站在大厅的灯底下打。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Tight on his eyes, the bulb reflected bright inside them
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: The pinned first chart in close-up, the thumbtack cap catching lamplight
Close-up over the open roster's first page: three hands stack one on another, palm on palm, ritual-like
A short length of red wool wound around a thumbtack and pinned beside the chart, first appearance
Back room fully lit now; three shadows side by side thrown across the wall
Young woman flips a ledger page and looks up over it
shots.sub: 我夜里盯到一个新票——联华网络。钱，在悄悄堆。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: Young man studies the page and taps its edge twice with one fingertip
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: After-close: the great exchange hall going dark bank by bank, while in the same frame the small back-room window across the street stays lit, light-versus-dark split
Black screen, white Chinese end card, subtle film grain
